bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_source.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_metadata.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_animation.rs, springboard/sdk/src/picture_writer.rs over springboard/render/src/cg/imageio (all formats); springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs and springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs remain the system-layer readers and writers
summary: Decoding and writing for PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO and TIFF (WebP is read only) live in springboard/render/src/cg/imageio, with EXIF, TIFF and GPS metadata, orientation, thumbnails and animation frames. Apps now reach them through the SDK: graphics_imageio and image_source for pixels and sizes, image_metadata for EXIF, GPS and upright decode, image_animation for frames and delays, and picture_writer for writing with metadata. Not yet verified on Midget. No XMP or IPTC, no HEIC, TGA or RAW, and no colour profile or HDR handling.

features.feature: Image source: decode from data or file
features.note: Built on parity/team-n-image-i-o; not yet verified on Midget. Reads the header first (format and size, refusing oversized pictures), then decodes any format of the cg::imageio codecs (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF; WebP read only) into premultiplied RGBA. Apps reach it through bifrost_app::image_source.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/picture_writer.rs (PictureWriter over cg::imageio::ImageDestination), springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs (encode, encode_jpeg); system layer: springboard/src/pngenc.rs:9, springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs:284, springboard/src/shell/photos/edit.rs:343
features.note: Built on parity/team-n-image-i-o; not yet verified on Midget. Apps write PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF and ICO with orientation, date, location, quality, frame delay and loop count. WebP is read only. The Photos and camera code still use their own encoders.

Wave 5 (w5-image-i-o, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No streaming tile provider.

gaps: No XMP or IPTC metadata in the SDK; the metadata block carries EXIF, TIFF and GPS only.
HEIC, TGA and RAW are not recognised by the codecs; WebP is read only.
The Photos and camera code still use their own encoders (springboard/src/pngenc.rs writes uncompressed PNG) and are not moved onto picture_writer.
APNG frame access is not verified.
No colour profile (ICC) or HDR gain map handling; images are treated as sRGB.
No tiled or streaming image provider for very large pictures.
Not yet verified on Midget: every row built on parity/team-n-image-i-o.
